blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No jackpot-winning tickets were recorded in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Saturday, Sept. 26, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 54-50-52-37-42-55 for a jackpot of ₱225.52 million. PCSO recorded no jackpot winner. For Lotto 6/42, the winning numbers were 16-41-19-05-26-31.
